description:
Navigate the topic taxonomy. Without `parent_slug`, returns the top-level roots (Politics, Business, Technology, etc.). With `parent_slug` set, returns the direct children of that topic. Topic slugs use a `parent/child` convention (e.g. `politics/elections`) and let agents browse the hierarchy to find well-named categories.

To find a topic by name instead of walking the tree, pass `query` (e.g. `artificial intelligence`): exact names rank first, then prefixes, then substrings (for a word of 3+ characters), each by story coverage, and `parent_slug` narrows the search to that subtree. The same name often sits under several parents, so read the ancestry before picking a slug. Topic slugs feed the `topic_slug` filters on `particle_podcast_resolve` and `particle_podcast_list_guests`.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

parent_slug.description: Topic slug or ID. Returns the direct children of this topic. Omit for top-level roots (Politics, Business, Technology, etc.). With query, limits the search to this topic's descendants.

query.description: Find topics by name: exact names first, then names starting with it, then (when it has a word of 3 or more characters) names containing it, each ranked by story coverage. Covers topics with at least 5 story clusters; browse with parent_slug for the long tail. Pages reach the top 200 matches.
